title: Zebra Agent Plugin Manifest
description: Draft manifest schema for Zebra extension plugins. Phase A contract only (EXT-0); implementation is Locked under EXT-PLUGIN-01. requested_capabilities and permissions are install-preview inputs only and NEVER form a Task grant.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped on breaking manifest changes.

version.description: Semantic version of this plugin package.

publisher.description: Publisher identity used in the stable component identity publisher/plugin@version#digest/...

scope.description: Default scope. Higher scope wins on name collisions across scopes; same-scope collisions remain ambiguous.

namespace.description: Optional explicit namespace. Defaults to the scope value.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or free-text license reference.

zebra.description: SemVer range of compatible Zebra versions, e.g. '>=0.1.0,<0.2.0'.

entry.description: The concrete extension this package contributes. v1 plugins declare exactly one entry kind.

skill_root.description: For skill-bundle: relative directory containing SKILL.md.

command.description: For mcp-stdio: absolute executable path (resolved and validated by Zebra config loader).

url.description: For mcp-http: https:// URL. http:// is rejected.

bearer_token_env.description: For mcp-http: env variable NAME holding the bearer token. The token itself never enters the manifest, events, logs, or Artifact storage.

requested_capabilities.description: Install-preview only. Never forms a Task grant. Each requested capability still requires normal Policy at use time.

provenance.description: Content digest and optional signature. digest is mandatory and pinned at install time.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical package content, computed and pinned at install.
